KEY FEATURES:
• 100-card ready-to-play Innistrad: Crimson Vow Commander deck
• Deck includes 2 traditional foils + 98 nonfoil cards
• 1 foil-etched Display Commander
• 10 double-sided tokens + life tracker and deck box
• Introduces 15 MTG cards not found in the main set

DESCRIPTION:
The Vampiric Bloodline Innistrad: Crimson Vow Commander Deck set includes 1 ready-to-play deck of 100 Magic cards (2 traditional foil, 98 nonfoil), 1 foil-etched Display Commander (a thick cardstock copy of the commander card with textured foil etched into the card’s border and art), 10 double-sided tokens, 1 deck box (can hold 100 sleeved cards), 1 life tracker, and 1 reference card—all using 98% less plastic than previous Commander decks, including packaging.
